refs/cairns-1935/cairns-triangulation-1935.txt:47-50 VERBATIM: "T H E O R E M . If an r-manifold, Mri of class one is covered by the
domains of a finite set of allowable coordinate systems, it can be
triangulated into the cells of a finite complex. Otherwise it can be
triangulated into the cells of an infinite complex."
